# **CubiKonce 2027**
​
## **Español**
​
¡Se celebra en Concepción la onceava edición de la competición **"CubiKonce"**, en esta ocasión llamada **"CubiKonce 2027"**! 
​
✨ **¡Los esperamos con ansias en esta competición!**
🍀 **¡Buena suerte, amigos cuberos!**
​
No te pierdas la oportunidad de ser parte de esta emocionante competición. **¡Prepárate para desafiar tus habilidades cuberas y disfrutar de un día lleno de diversión!**
​
**¡Nos vemos en Concepción!**

---
​
## **English**
​
The eleventh edition of the **'CubiKonce'** competition is taking place in Concepción, this time named **'CubiKonce 2027.'**! 
​
✨ **We eagerly await your participation in this competition.**  
🍀 **Good luck, cube enthusiast friends!**
​
Don't miss the opportunity to be part of this thrilling competition. **Get ready to challenge your cubing skills and enjoy a day filled with fun!**
​
**See you in Concepción!**

venue.name: Câmara Municipal de Vereadores de Osório
venue.address: Av. Jorge Dariva, 1211 - Centro, Osório - RS, 95520-000

items.information:
🇧🇷 **Português**
Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GurizaoemOsorio2027/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410).

Para esse campeonato, teremos modalidades acontecendo simultâneamente. O competidor deverá escolher entre **7x7 OU SKEWB** e **6x6 OU PYRAMINX**

Por favor, caso você se inscreva mas decida não ir ao campeonato, por favor nos informe para que possamos programar corretamente a quantidade de competidores.
O competidor poderá se inscrever em quantas modalidades desejar. Pedimos que não se inscreva nas modalidades que não possui intenção de participar.

É imprescindível ter lido as regras da WCA (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

🇺🇸 **English**
Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GurizaoemOsorio2027/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410).

For this competition, we will have events happening simultaneously. The competitor must choose between **7x7 OR SKEWB** and **6x6 OR PYRAMINX**.

Please, if you register but decide not to come for the competition, please let us know so we can better figure out the number of competitor's to expect.
The competitor can register for every event that he wants, we just ask to not register to events you're not certain at participating.

Every competitor must have read WCA's Rules (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

items.information:
Attendance is not required for the entire competition. However, please arrive at least **15 minutes** before your event's planned start time. Please bring your own puzzles for the events you are competing in.

## First-Time Competitors:
All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing. There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) for a basic overview of the rules.

## Implementation of 4-Pad
The World Cube Association has announced that as of January 2nd, 2027, all timed attempts must use a Speed Stacks G5 StackMat™ Pro Timer in 4-pad mode, as opposed to the previous 2-pad mode. This competition will be the first in Alberta to do so. You can read the WCA's announcement [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/adoption-of-4-pad-timing-august-2026).

## Notice of Filming and Photography:
Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.
